hha_arius.bar.arius_heir: Arius, Heir of the White Dragon
hha_arius.bar.nivaris: Solvane, Heart of the White Dragon
hha_arius.line.intro.seal: A White Throne seal. This far from home.
hha_arius.line.intro.seas: I crossed three seas to be rid of them.
hha_arius.line.intro.reason: A heart once lay beneath this ice. My blade remembers it, and every seal wakes the memory.
hha_arius.line.intro.test: Put it down. … No? Then show me what you carry it for.
hha_arius.line.dragon.name: Solvane.
hha_arius.line.dragon.polite: She was a dragon long before she was a blade. Be polite.
hha_arius.line.dragon.wake: Hear that? That is not the wind.
hha_arius.line.dragon.release: Solvane. Show them what you were.
hha_arius.line.home.astoria: Where I come from there's a village called Eirholm. This sanctum doesn't belong there. It belongs to the blade.
hha_arius.line.home.far: Astoria is farther than your maps go. I checked.
hha_arius.line.rumor.olympus: On my way here there was a temple on a marble mountain. Four stones wanted gifts from me. All I had was snow.
hha_arius.line.rumor.messenger: A messenger with wings on his sandals passed me twice. He never stopped. I don't think he does.
hha_arius.line.rumor.gate: They told me about a black gate with a red sky behind it, and a host who receives everyone. I stayed up here.
hha_arius.line.finale: No more storm. Just you and me.
hha_arius.line.end.weapon: You're not a weapon. A weapon wouldn't have stopped when it was over.
hha_arius.line.end.take: Take this. And throw the next seal into the sea.
hha_arius.line.end.heaven: That armour's from the marble mountain, isn't it? I hope they paid you well.
hha_arius.line.end.hell: Black netherite with soulfire. I'd rather not ask where from.
hha_arius.line.end.nivaris: She won't speak to me for a week now.
hha_arius.line.defeat: Go home. Take the seal with you. It doesn't belong here.
hha_arius.line.again.2: Another seal. You people don't learn.
hha_arius.line.echo: Just one part. Then we're done.
hha_arius.scene.cut_after: Only now do you hear the cut.
hha_arius.scene.dragon: One eye gold, one ice-blue. Like his.
hha_arius.scene.lift: Solvane carries you out into the highland.
hha_arius.scene.transform: The armour falls apart into frost. Underneath, he wears white.
hha_arius.scene.white_hole: A light that does not pull. It pushes.
hha_arius.msg.forming: The Sanctum of the White Blade is taking shape …
hha_arius.msg.forming_pct: The Sanctum of the White Blade is taking shape … %s %%
hha_arius.msg.fixed: Arius has his eyes on you.
hha_arius.msg.watching: He only watches. A white boundary lies between you.
hha_arius.msg.ko: You're knocked out and keep everything. You rejoin in the next part.
hha_arius.msg.latejoin: The fight is already running. You join in the next part.
hha_arius.msg.defeat: The snow settles. The seal is still in your pocket.
hha_arius.msg.inbox: %s items from the Sanctum are still waiting for you. They move into your inventory as soon as there is room.
hha_arius.msg.sent_home: The sanctum is quiet. You're back outside.
hha_arius.msg.busy: You're already part of an encounter.
hha_arius.msg.no_dimension: The Sanctum of the White Blade is missing (data pack not loaded).
hha_arius.msg.full: Every sanctum is in use right now. Try again in a moment.
hha_arius.adapt.arrows: Arius has adjusted to your arrows.
hha_arius.adapt.back: Arius now expects attacks from behind.
hha_arius.hint.downed: Solvane crashed into her own ice ridge. Her head is on the ground!
hha_arius.hint.takt_break: Rhythm broken! The partner is open.
hha_arius.hint.dragon_down: Solvane is down. Arius fights on alone.
death.attack.hha_arius.pressure: %1$s was crushed by a pressure front
death.attack.hha_arius.pressure.player: %1$s was crushed by a pressure front
